summary.headline: Winds, Triplicities, and Seven Climates
summary.text: Chapters 33–35 discuss the hot, cold, dry, and wet qualities of the four winds and the triplicities of Aries, Taurus, Gemini, and Cancer; the numbers of cities, villages, and camps in the seven climates; and judging when the Sun commits its disposition to the Moon in a revolution chart.
